title: Saving £200 a month for 5 years
caption: The pot grows faster as interest earns interest: after 60 monthly deposits at 0.5% a month it holds about £13,954, of which £12,000 is deposits.
alt: A curve rising from zero over 60 months, steepening, to about £13,954.
description: Each month's £200 earns 0.5% a month from the date it is paid.
After n months the pot is 200 × (1.005^n − 1)/0.005.
At n = 60 it is about £13,954; the other £1,954 is interest.

checks.name: after 60 months the pot is about £13,954
